description: Reviewed difference classes between astgen 1.10.6 (TypeScript 6) type maps and the native binary (TypeScript 7). A class not listed here fails lib/typemap/diff.mjs. Normalizations (union and object member order, quote style, typeof against a signature) live in lib/typemap/canon.mjs with their own tests and need no entry.

classes.reason: typescript-go returns no type for the identifier of a type reference, so the identifier takes the type of its enclosing reference (getTypeFromTypeNode), as the brief requires. TypeScript 6 gave the identifier the declared type (Promise<T>) and kept the longer string at the shared offset. The reference itself is typed identically.

TypeScript 6 printed the type of a CommonJS module or require() result as `typeof module.exports` or `typeof import("./m")`; TypeScript 7 writes the structure of the same type. The names inside are the same; only the printer chose differently. Checked on the JSDoc fixture (r17-jsdoc.js) and node-express-boilerplate.
